structure.notation: Shelf 1 is the top (mug display); shelves 2-8 contain books, top-to-bottom
structure.annex: 2026-08 re-cataloging: the middle column is now half display — M2 Egyptian pieces, M3 FRIENDS Funkos, M4 frames and candles, M6 the Smith-Corona typewriter. Its books consolidated into M5 (mystery), M7 (antique reference + the Mentor-UNESCO art series from M4) and M8 (dictionaries and atlases, the formerly anonymous row). Book ids are accession numbers: the prefix records where a book was first cataloged, not where it lives; real location = containing shelf.
